reviews_note: Only 2 verbatim reviews were recoverable, and NEITHER discloses the reviewer's name (the source is the business's own Instagram testimonial graphic, which shows a circular client photo + 5-star rating + quote, but no name text). Deep search for additional NAMED Google reviews was exhausted without success: Google Maps place page fetch returned no review content (JS-rendered, blocked), Birdeye has no listing for this business (verified via targeted search, only unrelated 'Bonita'- or 'Halo'-named businesses found), Yelp/Nextdoor have no page for this business, Facebook is blocked (503 / browser-incompatibility error), and imagestudios.co/localheadspa.com/swflinc.com show no individually-attributed reviews. IMPORTANT CORRECTION DURING RESEARCH: an early web-search summary surfaced three review-sounding quotes ('vibe is super clean and relaxing...', 'Staff really took their time...', '10/10 highly recommend...') attributed in the summary to Bonita Halo; on verification via targeted phrase search these quotes actually belong to a DIFFERENT, unrelated business (Halo Head Spa in Brandon, FL, and Anne Therese med spa) and were NOT used anywhere in this build. Per the no-invention rule, the site displays the 2 genuine quotes with the reviewer labeled 'Real client' (no fabricated name) rather than inventing author names.
palette_note: Dark base (templates/dark-v2, matching the moody/candlelit real photography style seen in the business's own Instagram content: dim ambient light, warm candle bokeh in the massage photo, dark-room red-light-device shot). Accent shifted from the skeleton's original gold (#d4a84b/#b8934a, 'gold dark original', already used) to a burnt copper/terracotta (#b5562f accent-deep / #cf7a4a accent-mid), derived by replacing every accent hex and rgba(212,168,75,*) token (protecting only the merktop-badge block, which stays gold per the pipeline rule) plus proportional shifts of the orb, btn-3d gradient, text-shine gradient and dark-band variant tones. Chosen to be distinct from templates/SKELETONS-V2.md's 'paletas ya usadas' list (coral fairy #c04e62, caramelo #a86a2e, esmeralda #2f7d5a, teal acero #4fb8b8, violeta dark #b18ae8, rosa dark, gold dark original) and, as far as visible without cross-batch coordination, from the other head-spa builds running in this same batch (Treasure Coast, ReflexPedi, PermabeauTea, Palms Salon).

photos.source_note: Pulled via scripts/ig_photos.py against the real Instagram account @bonitahaloheadspa (Railway ig-photo-service; this sandbox cannot reach instagram.com directly). The service returned all 12 of the account's recent posts, and every one is a Reel cover frame with a marketing caption/graphic baked into the pixels (short-form video ad style), consistent with the account being used mainly for promotional Reels rather than a plain photo feed. Also checked and rejected as a photo source: bonitahalo.glossgenius.com's 8 per-service images (static.glossgenius.com/public/service/... URLs) were downloaded and visually inspected -- ALL are generic licensed stock photography (a professional 'golden hoop scalp rinse' stock photo used industry-wide by head-spa GlossGenius listings, a stock couple's-massage photo with unrelated models, and one clearly AI-generated/digital-art image of a glowing head), NOT real photos of this business, its real staff, or its real space, so none were used anywhere on the site. Of the 12 real IG posts, 5 had genuine, non-text-covered photo content underneath or beside their caption and were cropped ONLY to remove the caption/graphic region (no content added or altered), which is the minimum bar set by precedent (serrano-handyman-kissimmee, also 5). The other 7 were either 100% covered by marketing text, a solid black/graphic frame (gift-card promo, Valentine's hearts, a starry night graphic), or a testimonial-screenshot graphic (bk-8, used only for its review TEXT, not as a gallery image, since it is a graphic/screenshot, not a photo).

build_note: Built from templates/dark-v2/index.html (Pure Artistry skeleton) via scripts/build_bonitahalobonitasprings.py (anchored assert-then-replace transformation, one Python file). Nav/footer/preloader monogram uses a text 'BH' badge (no image) since no real logo artwork exists for this business (avoids using an unrelated real photo or a fabricated logo as a stand-in). Because only 5 real curated photos were recoverable, the Experience section was reduced from the skeleton's default 2-image grid to 1 image, and the gallery grid was reduced from 6 tiles (1 wide + 5 square) to 3 tiles (1 wide + 2 square), using all 5 available real photos across hero (1) + experience (1) + gallery (3), with zero stock/invented/AI-generated photos anywhere on the site. Reviews section reduced from a 3-column grid to a 2-column grid to match the 2 genuine quotes actually available, with the reviewer honestly labeled 'Real client' rather than an invented name. GATE OK on first full pass: python3 scripts/gate.py bonita-halo-bonita-springs --lang en --forbid "Pure Artistry,pure.artistrysk,Orlando,Booksy,booksy,121705,Silk Press,Knotless,K-Tip,Grant St". Verified with local Playwright (headless) at 1440px and 390px viewports: zero horizontal overflow at either width, JSON-LD parses valid, zero em-dashes, html lang and applyLang default both correctly 'en'. NOTE: confirmed via direct testing against the pristine, unmodified templates/dark-v2/index.html that its .img-reveal elements never register isIntersecting=true under this sandbox's headless Chromium/Playwright combination (a pre-existing characteristic of the frozen, shared motion CSS/JS, not something introduced by this build) -- content is fully visible and correctly laid out once revealed (confirmed via forced-reveal screenshots and direct per-element screenshots); .reveal elements (the vast majority of the page's text/card content) DO reveal correctly on scroll in the same test.
